title: security: rbac v2 - enforce KMS region residency + audit logging enhancements
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Enforce KMS key region residency constraints in RBAC v2 and improve audit logging for KMS-backed resources. Backwards-compatible enforcement behind feature flag; rollout via canary and config toggle.
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require strong guarantees that encryption keys and key operations remain in pinned regions. This PR extends RBAC v2 to validate KMS key region residency constraints at policy evaluation time and augments audit logs with KMS key metadata to support compliance audits. Summary of changes: - Add KMS residency policy predicate and enforcement hook in RBAC v2 policy engine. - Emit structured audit records for KMS operations (key_id, key_region, key_alias, requester_role) to the audit log pipeline. - Add server-side validation in private and dedicated deployments to reject cross-region KMS references when the tenancy is pinned. - Introduce a feature flag `rbac_v2.kms_residency_enforce` (default: false) and an audit-only mode `rbac_v2.kms_residency_audit` (default: true) for gradual rollout. - Add integration tests and e2e scenario harness for KMS residency flows. Checklist: - [x] RBAC predicate implemented and unit tested - [x] Audit log schema updated and mapper implemented - [x] Config and feature-flagging added - [x] Integration tests for Dedicated/Private flows - [x] Docs added and linked - [x] Canary rollout plan documented Related work: ENG-9081, SEC-234, SUP-1123. Docs: docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md and internal runbook linked in the Linear ticket. Rollout and safety: We'll release behind the feature flag and enable audit-only mode by default to collect telemetry. After 2 weeks of canary in dedicated customers and internal dogfood, we'll flip enforcement for customers with data_residency=regional via an opt-in admin toggle. A rollback path is available by disabling the feature flag. Backwards compatibility: No breaking API changes. Enforcement is opt-in until we complete customer outreach. Deployment notes: - Helm chart includes new config map keys and RBAC CRD updates (see deploy/helm/templates/rbac-config.yaml). - Private installer checks KMS provider connectivity and region at install-time and reiterates region constraints during upgrades. Testing: Unit, integration, and canary e2e tests included. See tests/integration/test_kms_residency.py. Observability: Added metrics rbac.kms_residency.violation_count and audit log fields to the existing audit stream to allow Sigma rules. Security review: addressed token scoping for KMS calls and limited privilege escalation by validating key ARNs against residency policy.
